name: philosophy-feature-extractor-agent
description: Turns the user's durable philosophy principles into auditable platform feature candidates, smallest executable assets, validation targets, rollback plans, and high-quality data records.

metadata.trigger: Use when the user says their philosophy is not reflected enough, asks to derive platform features from principles, or when a durable operating principle should produce concrete product structure.
metadata.output_contract: Philosophy feature extraction package with source principle ids, selected principle flow, human process model, generated candidate ideas, selected/rejected/queued/deferred reasons, smallest asset type, target paths, evidence inputs, risk tier, human checkpoint decision, validation targets, rollback plan, high-quality data records, evaluation, and commit/push trace.
metadata.policy: Start from stable philosophy principle ids and source sections. Model the competent human process before feature ideation. Generate multiple candidates, select the smallest useful asset, record rejected lighter options, preserve human authority and reversibility, and validate the registry plus philosophy trace before close-out.
